requirements.title: Expose Dense Workflow Operations Views
requirements.description: The workflow-health UI must provide overview, inventory, search, runs, findings, fixes, and settings views with scenario selection, maturity ladder, asset counts, safety posture, artifact inspection, search filters, and deterministic fix previews.

validation.notes: UI tests and BAS captures verify dashboard, inventory, search, run detail, and fix preview states across desktop and mobile without overlapping controls.
